items.title: Building a no-code AI app on Amazon Aurora DSQL with agent skills, plugins, and MCP
items.summary: With AI coding agents and Amazon Aurora DSQL, you can turn data from existing business systems into working applications. This post shows how Kiro and the Aurora DSQL power take enterprise data extracts to a running catalog and inventory application through four prompts, covering schema design, data loading, IAM authentication, and concurrency handling.
items.creator: Sumeet Tripathi

items.title: Securing multi-team Amazon Neptune with tag-based access control
items.summary: Amazon Neptune now supports tag-based access control (TBAC) for data-plane operations. This post walks through three scenarios for isolating multiple teams on a shared fleet of Neptune clusters using AWS resource tags and IAM principal tags as conditions in IAM policies and service control policies.
items.creator: Brian M. Slater
